label: 好友：两位友善冒险者半身
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: FantasyFinal Chinese fantasy RPG social-category tab icon, single raster PNG asset.
Style/medium: Japanese light anime, cute chibi hand-painted fantasy game icon. Soft rounded proportions, polished painterly highlights and shading, warm brown hand-drawn contour lines; cozy storybook game artwork, consistent with a sunny anime RPG village. A compact, readable silhouette that remains recognizable at 20–28 pixels. This is a richly illustrated raster game asset, not a flat vector symbol.
Color palette: warm cream, honey gold, restrained turquoise teal, gentle brown contours. Friendly warm illumination.
Composition/framing: A single centered compact subject group, square canvas. Complete subject occupies about 70 percent of canvas width and height, leaving at least 15 percent clean empty transparent margin on every edge. Keep few strong shapes rather than many tiny details.
Scene/backdrop: Truly transparent alpha background; isolated cutout.
Constraints: Exactly one social tab icon per image. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, decorative UI frame, card, tile, medallion or disc behind the subject, border, background scene, ground plane, cast shadow outside the object, checkerboard, white backdrop, SVG, or vector appearance. Background pixels must genuinely have transparent alpha.
Primary request: Two friendly cute chibi fantasy adventurers shown together from the waist or upper chest upward, the clear icon for friends. Two distinct smiling faces with big round heads, soft brown hair, cream and teal travelling clothes, a small warm-gold clasp. The two companions face the viewer, close shoulder-to-shoulder in a balanced compact group. Keep both faces clearly separated, simple, warm and welcoming.
